description.en: Concept maps you can walk into — a DSH Web UI panel plugin.
description.zh: 能把讲义铺成一张走进去的概念图 —— DSH Web UI 面板插件。

description.en: A concept map panel: zoom into a branch and it becomes the new root; each concept carries definition, formal statement (LaTeX), intuition, examples, pitfalls, prerequisites, and the source page of the lecture notes.
description.zh: 概念地图面板：滚轮推进子分支，它就成为新的主图根；每个概念带定义、形式化（LaTeX）、直觉、例子、易错点、前置与讲义原文出处。
